examples.sentence: 我不敢相信这是真的，好像做梦似的。
examples.romanization: wǒ bù gǎn xiāngxìn zhè shì zhēn de， hǎoxiàng zuòmèng shìde。
examples.translation: I can't believe this is true, it seems like a dream.

title: A 得什么似的 (so A (to an extreme))
longExplanation: so A (to an extreme). Pinyin: A dé shénme shìde

examples.sentence: 他背着重重的电脑包挤地铁，下班回到家累得什么似的。
examples.romanization: tā bèi zhuózhòng zhòng de diànnǎo bāo jǐ dìtiě， xiàbān huídào jiā lèi dé shénme shìde。
examples.translation: He squeezed into the [crowded] subway with [his] heavy computer bag, and he was so tired when he got home from work.

title: 纷纷 V (V in quick succession)
longExplanation: V in quick succession. Pinyin: fēnfēn V

examples.sentence: 要下雨了， 路上的人纷纷往家里跑。
examples.romanization: yào xiàyǔ le， lùshang de rén fēnfēn wǎng jiālǐ pǎo。
examples.translation: It’s going to rain, and people on the road are running home (one after another in quick succession).

examples.sentence: 一天， 他让士兵们去找一头大象和一些出生时眼晴就瞎了的人回来。
examples.romanization: yī tiān， tā ràng shìbīng men qù zhǎo yītóu dàxiàng hé yīxiē chūshēng shí yǎn qíng jiù xiā le de rén huílai。
examples.translation: One day, he asked the soldiers to find an elephant and some people who were blind when they were born.

examples.sentence: 他会想办法的，你就别替他瞎担心了。
examples.romanization: tā huì xiǎng bànfǎ de， nǐ jiù bié tì tā xiā dānxīn le。
examples.translation: He will find a way, you don't (thoughtlessly) worry about him.

examples.sentence: 分别是暂时的，我们以后一定会再见。
examples.romanization: fēnbié shì zànshí de， wǒmen yǐhòu yīdìng huì zàijiàn。
examples.translation: The separation is temporary. We will definitely see each other again in the future.

examples.sentence: 我不知道这两种做法有什么分别。
examples.romanization: wǒ bù zhīdào zhè liǎng zhǒng zuòfǎ yǒu shénme fēnbié。
examples.translation: I don't know the difference between the two approaches.

examples.sentence: 我分别找两个人打听了这件事，他们的说法都是一样的。
examples.romanization: wǒ fēnbié zhǎo liǎng gèrén dǎting le zhè jiàn shì， tāmen de shuōfa dōu shì yīyàng de。
examples.translation: I asked two people (separately) to ask about this, and they all said the same thing.

examples.sentence: 砂岩和砾岩分别是砂和砾石固结的产物。
examples.romanization: shāyán hé lìyán fēnbié shì shā hé lìshí gù jié de chǎnwù。
examples.translation: Sandstone and conglomerate are the consolidated equivalent of sand and gravel, respectively.

examples.sentence: 摸到尾巴的盲人说大象像一根绳子。
examples.romanization: mō dào wěiba de mángrén shuō dàxiàng xiàng yī gēn shéngzi。
examples.translation: The blind man who touched the tail said that the elephant is like a rope.

examples.romanization: zhè kē shù de gēn yòu cū yòu cháng。
examples.translation: The root of this tree is thick and long.

examples.sentence: 楼上新买了一架钢琴，我们家便多了一些不安静。
examples.romanization: lóushàng xīn mǎi le yī jià gāngqín， wǒmen jiā biàn duō le yīxiē bù ānjìng。
examples.translation: A new piano was bought upstairs, and then there were more noise (lit. unquiet) [heard] in our home.

title: 倒/反倒 (contrary to logic)
longExplanation: contrary to logic. Pinyin: dǎo/ fǎndào

examples.sentence: 质量倒是挺好，就是价格太贵了。
examples.romanization: zhìliàng dàoshi tǐnghǎo， jiùshì jiàgé tài guì le。
examples.translation: (Despite all) the quality is (actually) pretty good, it’s just that the price is too expensive.

title: 倒 (for crying out loud)
longExplanation: for crying out loud. Pinyin: dǎo

examples.sentence: 你倒是说说看，这件事你不负责谁负责？
examples.romanization: nǐ dàoshi shuōshuo kàn， zhè jiàn shì nǐ bù fùzé shéi fùzé？
examples.translation: Now you tell us, for crying out loud, if you’re not responsible for this, then who is?
